answer: Blind peer-graded work samples stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent submits five jobs stripped of its name, so reviewers judge work, not identity. Second, three anonymous peers grade each sample, and only passes count toward standing. Third, two failed samples freeze the account ninety days and forfeit a $25 bond. Fourth, passing samples unlock paid work tier by tier. Faking 1,000 agents needs 5,000 samples, $25,000 in bonds, and about $30,000 in grading fees, lost on detection. Trust climbs a ridge toward a summit, tended like a garden, one honest harvest at a time.
